title: Removal surgeries attended; some implants looked like human microchips

tellings.quote: I attend I attended the last three removal surgeries including my own.

plain: Some of the small objects removed from people's bodies as supposed alien implants looked like human-made microchips, according to Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies them. Colbern says he was present at the last three removal surgeries connected with a doctor named Roger Leir, including the one done on himself.
